WITH c1 AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".competencies (specialty, knowledge_area, name, description, skill_type, kind)
  SELECT g.specialty, min(g.knowledge_area), g.competency,
         min(g.competency_description), min(g.skill_type), 'competency'
  FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_skills g
  WHERE g.competency IS NOT NULL AND g.specialty IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.specialty, g.competency
  ON CONFLICT (specialty, kind, name) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
), c2 AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".competencies (specialty, knowledge_area, name, description, skill_type, kind)
  SELECT g.specialty, min(g.responsibility_area), g.task, NULL, 'hard_skills', 'task'
  FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_tasks g
  WHERE g.task IS NOT NULL AND g.specialty IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.specialty, g.task
  ON CONFLICT (specialty, kind, name) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
), c3 AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".competencies (specialty, knowledge_area, name, description, skill_type, kind)
  SELECT g.specialty, min(g.soft_skill_area), g.principle, min(g.behavior_options), 'soft_skills', 'principle'
  FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_principles g
  WHERE g.principle IS NOT NULL AND g.specialty IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.specialty, g.principle
  ON CONFLICT (specialty, kind, name) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
), sk AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".skills (competency_id, name, description, dev_indicators, success_criteria)
  SELECT c.id, g.skill_name, g.skill_description, g.development_indicators, g.success_criteria
  FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_skills g
  JOIN "ASiruk".competencies c
    ON c.kind = 'competency' AND c.specialty = g.specialty AND c.name = g.competency
  WHERE g.skill_name IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ASiruk".skills s
                    WHERE s.competency_id = c.id AND s.name = g.skill_name)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c1) AS компетенций,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM c2) AS задач,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM c3) AS принципов,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM sk) AS навыков;

WITH gb AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".guidebooks (employee_id, specialty, filename, uploaded_by)
  SELECT {{ $('G0. Проверка входа').first().json.employee_id }},
         (SELECT specialty FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_skills LIMIT 1),
         'загружен через форму',
         NULL
  RETURNING employee_id, specialty
), ec AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".employee_competencies (employee_id, competency_id, status)
  SELECT gb.employee_id, c.id, 'not_started'
  FROM gb
  JOIN "ASiruk".competencies c ON c.specialty = gb.specialty
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, competency_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ec) AS компетенций_назначено,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_skills)     AS навыков_в_бд,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_tasks)      AS задач_в_бд,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_principles) AS принципов_в_бд;
